title: erigeron × burnatii var. vandasii
intro: Erigeron × burnatii var. vandasii, commonly known as Alpine Fleabane, is a rare and hybrid species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Fleabane include its ability to soothe and calm the mind and body, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Fleabane include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
